name: app-list-tile
title: AppListTile

public_api.constructor:
AppListTile({
  Widget? leading,
  required String title,
  String? subtitle,
  Widget? trailing,
  VoidCallback? onTap,
  bool isEnabled = true,
})

conventions_reminder: All colors/spacings/radii/durations via tokens — no hardcoded values
Hover feedback via opacity (0.9) when onTap provided (NOT scale)
Press feedback via opacity (0.8) with disableAnimations guard
Double quotes on all string literals
Top-of-file doc comment explaining purpose + state behavior
acceptance_criteria: Disabled state: opacity 0.5 and onTap null
completion_summary: Implemented AppListTile with title/subtitle/leading/trailing/onTap/onLongPress/isThreeLine/padding params, uses AppTypography.titleMedium for title and AppTypography.bodyMedium + ColorScheme.onSurfaceVariant for subtitle, default padding via Spacing tokens, disabled state via Opacity 0.5 when onTap is null.
